title: Airplanes Data File
description: Contract between the data collector (writer) and the frontend (reader) for frontend/public/data/airplanes.json. Originally scoped to a boilerplate {id, name} placeholder by the 001-project-boilerplate feature; extended here to the real aircraft attributes documented in docs/airplane-attributes.md once the data collector's Wikipedia fetch/filter/clean pipeline began producing real records.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the file.

weight.description: Max takeoff weight (MTOW) in kg, falling back to gross weight then empty weight if MTOW is unavailable. null if no weight field was usable.

type.description: Zero or more aircraft-type categories; an aircraft can legitimately belong to more than one (e.g. a VIP/BBJ variant is both Comercial and Executivo).

manufacturer.description: Zero or more manufacturers; an aircraft can legitimately have more than one (joint ventures, consortiums, later corporate successors).

wingPosition.description: null means unknown (source had no wing-position category), not 'no wings'.

landingGearType.description: null means unknown (source had no landing-gear category).

speedRegime.description: Determines the unit of maxSpeed. null if no usable speed field existed in either regime.

maxSpeed.description: Unit is implied by speedRegime: km/h when subsonic, raw Mach number when supersonic. Never converted between the two. null if unavailable.

serviceCeiling.description: Stored in meters; the frontend converts to feet for display.

image.description: Relative path (from frontend/public/data/) to the aircraft's locally stored image file, e.g. "images/f-16-fighting-falcon.jpg". null if no image was found.
